sourceRevision: RFC 0001 revision 0.1 plus proposed implementation clarifications

tasks.title: Freeze the implementation baseline
implementationSteps: Record SHA-256 hashes, titles, revisions, and dates of both supplied DOCX files. Preserve their originals.
Produce text/Markdown transcriptions preserving numbered sections, tables, examples, and normative keywords. Check every table row against the DOCX XML text; do not transcribe only headings.
Copy each C01–C14 plan decision into a decision record with source clause, selected behavior, rationale, and affected fixture family.

Draft a revision containing every **Specification clarification**, especially ready/diagnostics APIs, outer-ref handling, enhanced-template allowance, one router per document, refresh coalescing, and toast options. Explicitly mark it proposed until accepted by the project owner; implementation can follow this plan as its proposed baseline, but release cannot claim an accepted RFC while that decision is pending.
Record precedence: RFC public behavior, accepted clarification, design algorithm, then implementation detail. Resolve Design cache expiresAt and router ranking as C08/C11 specify.
Create an exclusion list matching 00-plan. Attach no estimates or promised dates.
tasks.acceptance: `baseline.sources` hashes both inputs; `baseline.decisions` has C01–C14; `baseline.clarifications` lists every change to public semantics with no hidden TBD; no source document is overwritten.

tasks.title: Initialize the workspace and pin tools
implementationSteps: Initialize a Git repository only if one still does not exist; do not create a remote or publish anything. Ignore node_modules, dist, browser reports, local secrets, and transient coverage; retain evidence manifests and source fixtures.
Create private workspace manifests for the C02 directories. Set root packageManager to `pnpm@12.10.1`, Node engine to `>=24.21.0 <25`, and node-version to 24.21.0 for the reproducible build runner.
Install the exact C01 versions, save the lockfile, and archive official registry version metadata plus integrity values. Use frozen-lockfile installs thereafter.

TypeScript options: strict=true, noUncheckedIndexedAccess=true, exactOptionalPropertyTypes=true, useUnknownInCatchVariables=true, declaration=true, sourceMap=true, target=ES2022, module=ESNext, moduleResolution=Bundler, lib=ES2022/DOM/DOM.Iterable. Browser code excludes Node ambient types.

Add cross-platform Node scripts rather than shell-specific command chains. Script names: `typecheck`, `test:unit`, `test:conformance`, `test:browser`, `test:security`, `build`, `validate:examples`, `check:generated`, `check:boundaries`, `check:size`, `bench`, `check:release`.

Run a minimal TS compile, Vitest assertion, esbuild classic/ESM build, and one Playwright page in Chromium/Firefox/WebKit. If a dependency combination fails, document the incompatibility and change the exact pin in C01 before proceeding.
tasks.acceptance: `workspace.clean-install` succeeds from empty node_modules; `workspace.lock` fails if package metadata diverges; `workspace.windows` and `workspace.linux` execute the same scripts; smoke results record actual tool versions.

tasks.title: Establish package boundaries and build entry points
implementationSteps: Define allowed imports: core→schema; data/forms/components→core/schema and declared service interfaces; runtime→core/data/forms/components; each optional module→schema/core's official module bridge only. Forms may consume a data action-service interface; it must not import controller implementation.
Put shared request/DOM service interfaces in core integration types to break cycles. Inject implementations during runtime composition.
Make build entry stubs for the required distribution filenames and CSS. Use classic IIFE for `.js`, ESM for `.mjs`, minification for release, source maps alongside output.

Configure ESM optional modules to import the public runtime's module bridge by relative distribution path, never bundle another core. Classic modules consume the existing `window.PlainUI` bridge and fail clearly if core is absent.
Add a source import-graph checker that rejects boundary violations and cycles. Ensure DOMPurify appears only in fragments, never core.
Generate development builds from the same entry source with debug assertions enabled. Do not maintain separate implementations for classic/ESM.
tasks.acceptance: `build.boundaries` deliberately illegal imports fail; `build.no-duplicate-core` optional artifacts exclude core implementation; `build.entries` all filenames exist; `build.no-eval` no eval/Function constructor appears in emitted browser code.

tasks.title: Create the directive and option schema
implementationSteps: Enter every registry row, dynamic family, alias, enum, default, value kind, placement, companion requirement, conflict, and optional module from 07-coverage.
Represent presence flags as empty-string-only, integer literals with exact min/max, and identifiers with the RFC regex. Do not parse attributes heuristically by looking at their contents.

Add cross-attribute rules: one HTTP method; resource requires empty template/get; GET forbids body; loop requires key; if/for conflict; model conflicts value/checked; show conflicts hidden; text conflicts owned children/outlet/component/field-error.
Add configuration schema from RFC §3.1 and C07, plus prop/behavior-specific schemas. Reject unknown keys recursively.

Define stable diagnostic codes for every validation rule, mapping to severity and redaction-safe template. Retain all codes named in either source and the plan; do not use free-form exceptions as public diagnostic identifiers.
Generate JSON schema/metadata and the directive reference table from this source. Include grammar/schema versions for fixture compatibility.
Add a checker that enumerates registry rows and requires valid, invalid, lifecycle coverage IDs for each spelling/family.
tasks.acceptance: `schema.aliases` canonical/data aliases match; `schema.collisions` duplicates fail; `schema.complete` all source rows map to tasks; generated files reproduce byte-for-byte.

tasks.title: Build the shared conformance fixture runner
implementationSteps: Define fixture fields: id, RFC references, HTML, config, module list, registrations, storage seed, HTTP script, steps, expected state/DOM/events/diagnostics, teardown expectations, browser requirements.

Provide steps for mount, awaitReady, set, dispatch, user input, resolve/reject request, advanceClock, flush, navigate, unmount, and inspect. Each wait has an explicit predicate and maximum timeout; no arbitrary sleeps in deterministic tests.
Run each compatible fixture once with classic local assets and once with ESM assets. Reset page, storage, registries, history, and server state between fixtures.

Create a local HTTP server able to hold responses behind named barriers, return chosen status/headers/body, redirect, close sockets, record requests, and expose two distinct origins. Never depend on public network services.
Inject clock/fetch/randomness only through private test service construction, not a supported production transport replacement API.
Capture ordered lifecycle events, binding commits, final state, request counts, normalized diagnostics, and instrumented live-owner/timer/listener/subscriber counts.
Ensure all test-created deferred promises/timers drain or cancel in finally. Add harness self-tests proving an intentional leak or unexpected request fails.
tasks.acceptance: `harness.parity` same fixture yields same result in both builds; `harness.race` barriers reverse completion order; `harness.leak` intentional leaked listener is detected; `harness.timeout` missing completion gives a useful bounded failure.

tasks.title: Implement configuration and diagnostic infrastructure
implementationSteps: Resolve ui-config by document ID; require exactly one script[type=application/json], parse as safe JSON, and report missing/duplicate/wrong-type elements.
Merge/validate C07 defaults, block, and programmatic overrides. Validate origin lists, URL base, locale, zone, integer ranges, enums, and CSRF header/meta names.
Return immutable resolved options. Do not store tokens read from meta in config.
Implement diagnostics subscription before mount, unsubscribe, stable location (root-relative child path plus directive), and one dispatch path for compile/runtime/network errors.

Redact all dynamic data; safe debug spans include offsets and directive names, not raw header/body/URL-template substitution values. Query strings and URL credentials are removed from displayed locations.
Implement inspector counters and debug gating. Counters change at allocation/release sites and cannot keep owners alive by holding references.
Catch diagnostic listener exceptions so user logging cannot break disposal or compilation.

tasks.title: Prove sanitizer size and strict CSP feasibility early
implementationSteps: Build a minimal fragment-only bundle importing the pinned DOMPurify. Configure explicit RFC tag/attribute sets and DOM-fragment output.
Serve a test page with external JS only, `script-src 'self'`, no unsafe-eval, and enforced Trusted Types where supported. Allow precisely the private `plainui-template` and `dompurify` policy names.

Prove developer template import parsing through the private core HTML service can validate inert templates without adding the sanitizer to core. Ensure scripts do not execute while importing or cloning a definition.
Prove untrusted sanitization strips directives and enhanced mode can retain only the published permitted subset, including inert declaration templates.
Exercise a native component import plus an HTML fragment on the same strict-CSP page. Log CSP violations as test failures.

Measure raw/gzip bytes of core scaffold, optional sanitizer bundle, and combined script set using the production compressor parameters in T094. Record remaining budget; do not claim final size conformance from a scaffold.
If the sanitizer makes the combined budget unattainable, create a numerical-budget revision proposal now. Do not replace it with regex, loosen policy, or silently exclude dependency bytes.
tasks.acceptance: `spike.csp-template`, `spike.csp-fragment`, `spike.no-script-execution`, `spike.allowlist`, and recorded size evidence exist. This is a feasibility gate; T062 still supplies production hardening.

tasks.title: Implement safe JSON and writable paths
implementationSteps: Normalize JSON with iterative traversal to avoid stack overflow on deeply nested input data. Track active ancestry for cycle detection, not a global seen set that rejects harmless repeated references.
Read property descriptors before values; reject getters/setters, symbols, class prototypes, sparse-array holes normalized to null only at explicit JS boundary, and prohibited keys at every depth.
Normalize undefined to null, reject nonfinite numbers, and use null-prototype internal object records.
Parse the path subset in C05 with source spans. Distinguish literal array index from object property. Reject forbidden keys before lookup.
Implement immutable path replacement, missing-intermediate errors, bounds checks, and root-cell writability checks. Return changed path prefixes for invalidation.
Expose detached frozen snapshots; never return internal mutable state from public get or props.
tasks.acceptance: `json.pollution` tests nested/computed forbidden names; `json.getter` getter invocation count stays zero; `json.cycle`, `json.class`, `json.undefined`, `path.sibling-sharing`, `path.readonly`, `path.missing-container`, and snapshot mutation tests pass.

tasks.title: Implement tokenizer and Pratt expression parser
implementationSteps: Tokenize exact literals/operators/punctuation, tracking UTF-16 source offsets and total UTF-8 input bytes. Check 16 KiB before tokenization.
Parse literals, quoted-key objects, arrays, identifiers, unary/binary operators, ternary, dot/index access, and allowed identifier-call syntax using the C05 precedence table.
Track parenthesization explicitly for coalescing-mix validation. Reject assignment, loose equality, new, functions, arrow functions, template strings, regex literals, and member-method calls.

Enforce maximum AST depth 128 independently of parser recursion; check a guarded recursion counter before each Pratt descent and separately track constructed member-chain depth so hostile nesting cannot overflow first.
Store spans on AST nodes and parse error diagnostics. Reject leftover tokens and duplicate literal object keys.
Add an LRU AST cache of 512 entries keyed by grammar version, parser mode, and source; invalid parses may be cached as errors without retaining root state.
tasks.acceptance: `parse.precedence` exhaustive operator-pair matrix; `parse.nullish-mix`, `parse.unicode-bytes`, `parse.depth-128-129`, `parse.strings`, `parse.no-executable-syntax`; fast-check arbitrary text terminates with AST or bounded error.

tasks.title: Implement evaluator and built-in formatters
implementationSteps: Evaluate against an injected lexical read interface; return EvalResult plus tracked dependencies and nonfatal missing-value state. Never evaluate generated JS.
Implement own-property lookup, null chaining, array indices/length, forbidden computed keys, identity equality, and exact truthiness. Strings expose no methods or `.length`; len supplies length.
Implement typed arithmetic/order, zero-division and finite-result checks, boolean/coalescing short circuit, ternary, and the out-of-band failure semantics in C05.
Count AST steps/property reads against a single invocation budget. Stop at step 10001 before executing another operation.

Implement len, json, number, currency, date. Use string code-unit length for len; object length counts own enumerable keys. Currency uses Intl validation. Date-only input must match an actual Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD date; render its date components without timezone day shift. Timestamp input must be ISO with explicit Z/offset, or a finite epoch-millisecond number; reject ambiguous timezone-less date-times.
Cache Intl instances in a bounded 128-entry LRU. Custom formatter output passes safe JSON normalization; promises and side-effectful writes during formatter execution are rejected.

tasks.title: Implement scopes and extension registries
implementationSteps: Create scopes with explicit lexical parent and owner links. Register declarations before evaluating any dependent binding.
Reject duplicates across all declaration kinds and reserved names. Allow shadowing in child scopes; do not permit same-scope duplicates.
Implement refs as lexical names with one live element per name per scope; never return refs as expression values.
Build immutable command/formatter/behavior/adapter registries with identifier validation, duplicate/built-in rejection, and adapter version metadata. Freeze at compilation start.
Supply component isolation boundaries and context cells for store, route, props, and lifecycle/event values without making them writable.
Implement app-scope versus lexical-scope API resolution explicitly; app.refresh cannot reach an arbitrary local resource.

tasks.title: Implement owners, ranges, and deterministic disposal
implementationSteps: Implement C04 Owner/DomRange and a WeakMap from owned nodes to ownership records. IDs are monotonically increasing per root.
Provide createOwner, registerDisposer, createRange, insertRange, moveRange, and disposeOwner primitives. DOM operations use document fragments and comment anchors.
Mark the entire disposed subtree inactive before abort callbacks can fire; run cleanup in C06 order and isolate exceptions.
Maintain lifetime links for projected content and destination-linked fragment insertion without creating disposal cycles. A disposer token guarantees once-only invocation.
Abort owned event listeners, pending postflush work, timers, resource subscriptions, and behavior hooks through the same protocol.
Prevent crossing root/ignore boundaries. Add consistency assertions that anchors share a parent and ranges are contiguous before moves.

tasks.title: Implement state cells and dependency tracking
implementationSteps: Instantiate local/store defaults through safe deep copies. State cell source and writability are immutable metadata.
Implement synchronous get/set visibility and immutable writes through T008 paths. Increment versions only when a primitive/identity value changes.
Record exact path reads during evaluation. Whole-object reads, length/iteration reads, and descendant reads use distinct dependency keys.
Invalidate parent replacement descendants; invalidate child writes for child, ancestor whole-object, and iteration readers, while leaving unrelated sibling-leaf readers untouched.
Replace dynamic dependency sets after successful evaluation; retain the last safe set on evaluation failure to permit recovery after source changes.

Implement batch depth with synchronous callback semantics. Detect a returned thenable and throw BATCH_ASYNC; already synchronous writes remain committed, since batch is not rollback. Always decrement depth in finally.

tasks.title: Implement derived values and flush scheduling
implementationSteps: Create per-root deduplicated queues, schedule the first microtask on transition from clean to dirty, and enforce phase order from C06.
Evaluate derived values before readers with DFS dependency traversal; keep an evaluation stack and mark only the detected cycle disabled with DERIVED_CYCLE.
Preserve last valid values on expression limit failure; normal invalid type results publish null plus diagnostic. Prevent recursive reevaluation loops.
Skip work for dead owners and remove disposed jobs from queues. Writes during flush schedule a new pass without recursive flush calls.
Implement cancellable afterFlush; tasks run only after all earlier phases in that pass. A postflush write creates another pass.
Count complete passes per microtask and stop before pass 101, emitting one UPDATE_LOOP for the root. Unmount remains usable.

tasks.title: Implement browser persistence
implementationSteps: Compile persistence only on an unambiguous state/store declaration with explicit nonempty key and valid session/local enum.
Claim the namespaced key, read the selected Storage object inside try/catch, and validate the envelope/version/value before first derived evaluation.

Restore the whole declared object only when it has the same declared top-level keys; wrong/missing/extra keys restore defaults and diagnose. Type evolution is application-managed through namespace version.
Coalesce changed declaration snapshots into one JSON serialization/storage write after each settled flush. Do not serialize resources/props/refs or descendants.
Storage denial/quota/JSON failures produce nonfatal diagnostics while live state stays committed. Release key claims on disposal.
Document and test that session reset does not clear persistence, and no storage-event synchronization exists.

tasks.title: Implement directive normalization and compile validation
implementationSteps: Walk DOM nodes and template content explicitly. Map data-ui-* to canonical names while retaining source name/location.
Reject duplicate spellings, malformed dynamic-family suffixes, unknown directives, nonempty presence flags, illegal placement, missing companions, and sink ownership conflicts from schema.
Treat ui-ignore host attributes normally but do not traverse/observe its descendants. Treat definition/import/route templates as declarations rather than active content.
Build a staged BindingPlan per owner with phases for scope, declarations, structure, components, values, events, behaviors, resource start.
Separate parse/validate from activate. Invalid local plans retain original HTML and attach no invalid handler; root configuration errors prevent all activation.
Capture source templates for later branch/list/component instantiation without mutating inert source content.
tasks.acceptance: `compile.data-alias`, `compile.empty-flags`, `compile.unknown`, `compile.ignore`, `compile.conflicts`, `compile.local-fallback`, `compile.declarations-first` pass, with CLI-compatible structured rule IDs.

tasks.title: Implement root startup and distribution semantics
implementationSteps: Discover document ui-app roots only in classic boot after DOM readiness; require unique nonempty names and reject nested roots before any mount.
Implement C03 App lifecycle and shared document mount markers; scope all application state/caches/registries to the App.

Apply module installers, validate options, discover definitions/imports/routes, compile declarations, evaluate derived, instantiate structures, bind values, activate listeners/behaviors, then start eligible resources.

Defer component instances until imports resolve, but allow independent bindings to activate; imported instance failure must not indefinitely delay unrelated content. ready waits for bounded import resolution and initial plan completion.
Remove ui-cloak only after that owner's first successful binding flush. Leave failed owner cloak in place with diagnostics; do not claim root-fatal readiness.

Implement synchronous idempotent unmount and ready rejection if interrupted during compilation. Stop classic auto-discovery after its initial pass; application-authored additional roots require explicit mount.

tasks.title: Implement text, property, and attribute sinks
implementationSteps: ui-text accepts primitive/null and uses textContent; reject array/object unless formatted. Do not interpolate ordinary text nodes.
Implement the exact bind allowlist; resolve ui-src/ui-href aliases to the same sink. Reject on*, style, srcdoc, data-ui-*, and unlisted names before evaluation.
Use DOM properties for value/checked, presence/removal for boolean attributes, string values for other permitted attributes, and removal on null. ARIA false becomes string `false`, not removal.

Validate href/src using context URL policy after evaluation and URL resolution; forbidden URL updates remove the unsafe attribute and emit URL_POLICY. Never leave a newly requested unsafe URL installed.

ui-class tracks its own tokens and preserves initial static tokens; object values must be booleans. A token static and dynamically false remains present because the framework does not own its static occurrence.
ui-show applies RFC truthiness to hidden. Compare previous normalized values and skip equal DOM writes.

tasks.title: Implement conditional template chains
implementationSteps: Group adjacent if/else-if/else templates while ignoring only whitespace text and comments. A non-whitespace sibling terminates a chain; orphan else/else-if is invalid.
Reject multiple else branches, branches after else, non-template structural directives, and if+for on the same template.
Create one anchored owner range per chain. Evaluate expressions in order and select the first truthy branch; do not evaluate later branch conditions unnecessarily.
If selection changes, compile the new branch plan, dispose previous child owner, clone/insert selected content, create its scopes, and activate through scheduler phases.
If selection stays the same, preserve existing nodes/state/requests. Empty selection retains anchors only.
Invalid branch evaluation retains last successful branch for limit failure; ordinary null/type failure counts false and diagnoses.

tasks.title: Implement keyed list reconciliation
implementationSteps: Parse `item[, index] in expression` without splitting inside expression tokens. Validate alias names, collisions, and mandatory ui-key.
Treat null as empty; reject non-array values. Evaluate every new key in a temporary read-only item/index scope before changing any live alias or DOM.
Require string/finite-number keys and type-preserving Map identity; normalize -0 to 0 because numeric equality considers them equal. Reject duplicate keys atomically.
Prepare new owners/plans before mutation. For retained keys update read-only aliases, preserving their local state even when the item object changes.
Dispose absent keys, create new anchored item ranges, and move whole ranges into final order using a right-to-left anchor insertion walk. Do not add LIS optimization initially.
Keep focus on moved nodes. If the focused node is removed, focus the list's nearest containing element with temporary tabindex=-1 unless focus already moved deliberately during cleanup.

tasks.title: Implement mutation observation and external DOM changes
implementationSteps: Observe each root for childList/subtree and directive-attribute changes; filter ignore descendants without compiling them.
Reconcile MutationRecords against transaction journal and final connectivity. Framework insert/remove/move operations must not remount nodes when delivery occurs later.
Compile genuinely new app-authored nodes exactly once under the nearest active owner, with declarations and local failure behavior identical to initial mount.
For a moved complete owned range within one lexical scope, preserve ownership. Across scopes, dispose old ownership and recompile from source with defaults; do not carry old local state.
Diagnose declaration attribute edits as unsupported, retaining the compiled original behavior. Plain static attribute changes remain browser behavior.
Dispose disconnected owned nodes/ranges after the observer batch, excluding nodes reinserted safely in the same batch. Abort observation before root teardown.

tasks.title: Implement command parsing and safe event snapshots
implementationSteps: Parse semicolon-separated exact-name calls with optional final semicolon; reject empty interior commands, arbitrary statements, and nested effect calls in expression arguments.
Compile set/toggle first arguments as writable paths; all other arguments are pure expression ASTs. Share invocation budget across arguments.
Validate DOM event names and `.prevent/.stop/.once/.self`; reject duplicates, unknown modifiers, modifiers on lifecycle handlers, and collision with declarative request trigger.
Snapshot only type/key/button/value/checked/detail. Normalize component detail with safe JSON; omit live Event/target/DOM references. Expose null for inapplicable fields.
Apply self filtering before prevent/stop/once consumption; prevent/stop occur synchronously during native dispatch. Command execution then awaits sequentially.
Register listeners through owner disposal. Once removes the listener on the first eligible event even if the handler later fails.

tasks.title: Implement core command execution
implementationSteps: Implement set and toggle as immediate state writes; wrong boolean/path or expression failure stops the handler before further effects.
Implement emit with bubbling/composed CustomEvent from the current host and safely normalized detail; forbid reserved request lifecycle event names as component emissions.
Implement focus by lexical ref lookup, wait for flush, require a connected focusable target, and cancel if owner is disposed while waiting.

Route refresh/reset/navigate/open/close/toast through registered service interfaces. Missing optional UI/router services produce MODULE_MISSING where required; navigate has native same-origin fallback when router is absent.
Invoke custom commands with scoped API/signal/host/refs/event snapshot; await promises sequentially, catch failures, diagnose COMMAND_ERROR, and stop only that handler.
Check liveness before invocation and after each await; refuse postdisposal writes through retained context APIs. Do not roll back completed earlier commands.

tasks.title: Complete root and lexical public APIs
implementationSteps: Publish exact method signatures and App.ready/onDiagnostic/inspect clarifications. Restrict mutable operations by lifecycle state.
Provide public readonly snapshot types, command/formatter/behavior/adapter contexts, normalized errors, diagnostics, route/resource/action record types, and module installer types.
Define rejected/throwing behavior consistently: synchronous invalid API inputs throw a typed PlainUIError carrying code; async work rejects; declarative faults diagnose and localize.
Implement scoped afterFlush cancellation and beforeNavigate registration through service interfaces without exposing owner/scheduler internals.
Add plain JS examples plus compile-time accepted/rejected TS fixtures for each API. Never require TypeScript in examples.
Ensure uninstall/unmount cleans public subscriptions and returned unregister functions remain idempotent.

tasks.title: Close foundation conformance and lifecycle gate
implementationSteps: Compose nested local state, store persistence, derived chains, if branches, keyed components-as-future-hosts, bindings, refs, and async commands into one fixture.
Run 100 mount/update/reorder/unmount cycles with instrumented counts. Require zero framework owners/listeners/timers/queued jobs after every unmount.
Reverse branch switches during pending async commands and remove ranges during flush; assert no later writes or double cleanup.
Run parser property suite with fixed reproducible seed and at least 10,000 generated strings; save minimized failing inputs as permanent fixtures.
Compare classic and ESM outcomes for the entire completed foundation registry subset.
Record passing fixture inventory and remaining module placeholders. Do not mark data/forms/components complete from stubs.
tasks.acceptance: M1 evidence names exact build and test results; every foundation directive has valid/invalid/disposal coverage; no unresolved foundation blocker remains.

tasks.title: Compile and resolve URL templates
implementationSteps: Tokenize literal segments and balanced `{expression}` regions using expression string/delimiter rules; do not split braces inside strings/objects. Literal raw unmatched braces fail; `%7B/%7D` stay literal URL content.
Reject substitutions in scheme/authority by parsing a sentinel-filled template and determining component positions before evaluation. Validate the final URL again after substitution.

Evaluate scalars: encode string/boolean/finite number using encodeURIComponent; null returns an incomplete result; array/object/type/limit failures return an error. Encoded slashes stay inside one substituted component.
Resolve requests against api.baseUrl; leading slash uses its origin. Resolve navigation against the document URL through a separate mode.

Evaluate ui-query as a safe string-keyed object. Remove every literal query occurrence for a supplied key; append its scalar or array values in insertion order; null omits the key and null array elements are omitted. Reject nested arrays/objects and nonfinite values.
Strip request fragments, reject URL userinfo, non-HTTP(S), and origins outside the normalized allowlist. Preserve canonical query pair order as C08 requires.
tasks.acceptance: `url.encoded-slash` id=`a/b` becomes `a%2Fb`; `url.null` suspends; `url.query-replace` `/x?q=old&q=older` plus `{q:['a','b']}` yields two new values; `url.authority`, `url.credentials`, `url.protocol`, and `url.relative-base` pass.

tasks.title: Build immutable request drafts and final policy validation
implementationSteps: Define draft fields method, URL, headers, credentials, body, responseMode, timeoutMs, retry, adapter identity, epoch, owner signal, and consumer generation. Body is absent, JSON bytes, URLSearchParams, or FormData.

Merge app/endpoint headers case-insensitively; endpoint null deletes an inherited value. Reject non-string non-null header values, invalid header names/values, forbidden browser headers, and Sec-/Proxy- names using a published tested policy table.
Set Accept only if absent; set Content-Type for JSON/form; reject explicit multipart Content-Type so the browser can supply its boundary. GET body is always invalid.
Run adapter.prepare on a detached draft, then rebuild Headers and validate URL/origin/method/credentials/body again. Do not trust its earlier validated input.

After prepare, read the CSRF meta token for same-origin unsafe methods (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE). Missing/empty token fails before fetch; override any conflicting supplied header with the current token. Do not send this configured token cross-origin.
Freeze metadata after validation; retain transport body in private storage. Omit all body/header values from diagnostics and cache inspection.

tasks.title: Implement adapters and normalized errors
implementationSteps: Register identity version 1 automatically; unknown adapter names fail the affected declaration. Custom adapters must have nonempty version strings.
Implement prepare/success/error optional hooks and default behavior. Copy/freeze hook context metadata so one subscriber cannot alter another.

Normalize failures to all seven error fields. Default messages are fixed safe text by kind/status, fields={}, code/requestId=null unless a safe mapping supplies them, retryable derived from transport rules.

Preserve HTTP status for HTTP errors; status=null for network/timeout/security before response. Adapter exceptions become kind=adapter without exposing thrown stack or arbitrary message in production.
Normalize success hook output with T008. Validate error-hook output kinds, integer status, strings, field string arrays, boolean retryable; invalid output becomes ADAPTER_ERROR.

Liveness/epoch/generation checks run before and after every hook await. Apply C08's separate per-hook deadline; hook expiry is kind=adapter/code=ADAPTER_TIMEOUT and is not retryable. Abort does not become adapter error. Read response bodies only in transport, never again in adapters.
tasks.acceptance: `adapter.envelope`, `adapter.validation-map`, `adapter.async-stale`, `adapter.non-json`, `adapter.invalid-error`, `adapter.throw`, `adapter.version-cache` pass with literal expected normalized objects.

tasks.title: Implement Fetch transport and response decoding
implementationSteps: Call browser Fetch with the immutable draft, redirect:'error', credentials, and a linked AbortController. Reject opaque/opaqueredirect responses as security failures.

Keep one attempt deadline covering fetch and body consumption; clear it before invoking response adapters, which use their separate C08 hook deadline. Distinguish transport timeout abort from caller/owner cancellation with an explicit reason token.
Read successful/failed body once as text. Treat 204 or zero-length 2xx text as null. Whitespace-only JSON text is nonempty and must parse successfully or fail.

For nonempty JSON success require media type application/json or `application/*+json`, ignoring parameters/case; parse with JSON.parse then safe-normalize. Wrong media type is parse-kind RESPONSE_TYPE; malformed JSON is parse-kind RESPONSE_PARSE.

HTTP non-2xx never becomes success. Parse JSON error bodies only when JSON media type and valid syntax; otherwise supply null parsed body to error hook with safe default HTTP message. Do not render raw error HTML/text.

HTML response mode delegates sanitized handling to fragments after text/html validation; no JSON resource receives HTML. Capture correlation header `x-request-id` only as bounded text (maximum 256 characters), never as executable markup.
Always clear deadline and abort listeners in finally, including decoding/adapter exceptions.

tasks.title: Implement attempt retries and cancellation
implementationSteps: Accept retry count 0–3 for GET; reject retry on mutation directives at validation. Attempts total `1 + retry`.
Retry network failures, deadline timeouts, HTTP 502/503/504 only, with delays 500/1000/2000 ms. Do not inspect arbitrary adapter retryable=true to expand this list.
Allocate a fresh controller/deadline for each attempt. Check operation signal/epoch/liveness before starting and after delay.
Register backoff timer with operation owner; cancellation clears it immediately and resolves operation cancellation, not a timeout error.
Preserve only final accepted failure as resource/action error. Intermediate failures do not invoke lifecycle error handlers.
Never replay POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE automatically, including after adapter or timeout failures.
tasks.acceptance: `retry.timeline` fourth attempt starts after cumulative delays 3500 ms excluding attempt durations; `retry.no-400-500-parse`, `retry.cancel-backoff`, `retry.per-attempt-timeout`, `retry.mutation-once` pass.

tasks.title: Implement request keys and shared in-flight GETs
implementationSteps: Encode cache key fields with length-prefixed canonical segments to prevent delimiter collisions. Digest effective header sequence with the shared SHA-256 service; never use a redacted header list as actual identity.
Implement root-local inFlight Map keyed by flight identity; track subscriber ID, owner, generation, key, epoch, callbacks, and active state.
Subscribe an eligible GET to an existing compatible flight or create one. Do not deduplicate non-GET methods or incompatible timeout/retry policies.
Cancel a consumer by removing its subscription; abort transport only at zero subscribers. A removed subscriber receives no later data/error callback.
Before notifying each remaining consumer, require active owner, current generation, matching key, matching epoch, and valid invalidation generation.
Delete settled flights even if callbacks throw; isolate subscriber callbacks. Never let old invalidation generations populate settled cache.
tasks.acceptance: `flight.shared-count` two resources→one fetch; `flight.partial-cancel` first dispose leaves fetch alive; `flight.last-cancel` aborts; `flight.secret-header-distinct`, `flight.retry-policy-distinct`, `flight.old-generation`, `flight.callback-throws` pass.

tasks.title: Implement bounded resource cache and invalidation generations
implementationSteps: Maintain per-root LRU Map with data, acceptedAt, adapter identity, epoch, and invalidation generation; never retain errors.
On usable read move entry to newest; insertion evicts oldest until size<=maxEntries. maxEntries=0 bypasses retained entries.
Calculate freshness per consumer as `ttl>0 && now-acceptedAt<ttl && generation-current`; exact boundary is stale. ttl=0 never reuses a settled entry.
Keep resource controllers' own settled values after cache eviction. Cache eviction alone does not clear visible data or refetch.
On invalidation advance key generation, mark all attached consumers stale, cancel/supersede older revalidation subscribers, and notify eligible automatic controllers once.
Implement coalesced explicit refresh versus new mutation invalidation per C08. Concurrent refresh callers receive the same accepted-generation outcome.

tasks.title: Implement resource records and load state machine
implementationSteps: Register resource read-only cell before bindings evaluate. Initialize data=null,status=idle,loading=false,refreshing=false,error=null,empty=false,stale=false,updatedAt=null and private hasSuccess=false.
On complete new key, clear different-key settled data and advance generation. On incomplete URL, clear previous entity and enter idle without fetching.
First fetch sets loading=true,status=loading; same-key fetch after success sets refreshing=true,status=success while retaining data. Both clear error.

Accepted success commits normalized data, hasSuccess=true, success status, loading/refreshing=false, correct empty for null/empty string/empty array only, updatedAt=acceptedAt, and freshness-derived stale.

Accepted failure retains data only from successful same key, sets status=error/error record, and clears pending flags. Cancellation restores the current generation's last settled snapshot without introducing error.
Track URL/query/header dependencies and reevaluate identity when they change. Adapter/header asynchronous work cannot make an obsolete key current.
Emit lifecycle handlers through the shared dispatcher only after records and DOM settle; resource declarations support success/error/finally too.

tasks.title: Implement resource activation modes and freshness observability
implementationSteps: auto resources start after initial bindings and automatically respond to eligible dependency changes. manual resources never initiate without refresh.
visible resources observe the declaration template's nearest containing Element, excluding disconnected/template-content-only targets. Diagnose missing/unobservable parents.
On first intersection, disconnect that resource observation and permanently behave as auto until disposal. Scope visibility state does not reset on ui-show hiding.
Use the earliest positive TTL deadline among live consumers to schedule a shared root timer that updates stale flags; reschedule when consumers/entries change. No automatic fetch solely from expiry.
Invalidation refreshes active auto and already-visible consumers; marks manual/not-visible consumers stale. Explicit refresh works for all modes.
Stop visibility observers/timers on disposal and avoid registering a new observer from a late callback.

tasks.title: Implement session reset and public resource refresh
implementationSteps: app.resetSession increments epoch before touching controllers; abort resource/action/import-related authenticated operations where applicable, clear flights/cache, reset resource/action records to idle.

Prevent old async prepare/success/error hooks and fragment candidates from committing under previous epoch. Static component definition imports are not authenticated resource data; root unmount still aborts them.
Preserve declared local/store/persisted state and explain this in the logout example.
Implement lexical and app-scope refresh resolution; reject unknown names/read-only nonresource names synchronously or through command diagnostics as appropriate.

A refresh promise resolves only after next accepted data and binding flush. Failure rejects normalized error; disposal/supersession/session reset rejects AbortError; incomplete URL rejects RESOURCE_SUSPENDED.
Ensure resetSession does not start fresh requests with credentials being cleared; subsequent explicit refresh can restart.

tasks.title: Compile action declarations and action records
implementationSteps: Distinguish resource template from action by ui-data. For action require one method, validate method-specific options, and select submit/change/click default trigger.
Resolve ui-trigger only from supported DOM events; reject duplicate request and ui-on same-trigger binding on that element.
Create optional named read-only action cell in nearest lexical scope plus `$action` context for action element descendants. Initialize pending=false,status=idle,data=null,error=null.
Compile URL/query/headers/body once into AST plans; do not send anything during compilation. Register no listener if the action configuration is statically invalid.
Validate form encoding/defaults and lifecycle handlers before activation; delegate forms to T042–T045.
HTML action options require fragments module/target/swap and cannot appear on a resource. JSON actions reject target/swap/enhance options.

tasks.title: Implement action debounce and concurrency
implementationSteps: Accept eligible triggers into the C09 preparation/debounce pipeline; cancel/restart trailing timers with newest captured input.
At operation start increment generation, establish epoch/signal, set pending/status, clear prior error, and apply pending affordances.

For drop, ignore triggers while pending without changing data or timer. Disable native form submit buttons with original-state+operation tokens; for nonnative custom trigger hosts use aria-disabled and event suppression.

For replace, cancel prior consumer/transport subscription at new operation start, permit old finally only while scope active, and forbid old completion from clearing the new pending flag or reenabling its controls.
On settlement restore only framework-owned disabled/aria-busy/aria-disabled values if their token still matches. Preserve controls already disabled by application state.
On dispose cancel timers, operations, and pending affordances without user lifecycle commands. Document that client abort cannot undo a server mutation.

tasks.title: Implement action settlement and lifecycle handlers
implementationSteps: Commit pending=false plus status/data/error in one state transaction before handlers. Preserve last successful same-action data on failure; expose latest normalized failure separately.
On successful non-GET mutation, resolve all ui-invalidate names lexically, collect distinct resource keys, advance each once, and schedule active automatic subscribers before success handlers.
Flush records/DOM/accessibility, then run success or error; protect finally so it executes even if the preceding handler throws/rejects.
Build lifecycle scope with result/error/action/event/canceled values. For cancellation, skip success/error and run finally only if owner remains active.
Keep accepted HTTP success successful when a command or invalidation resource fails; surface those failures through their own diagnostics/records.
For unnamed action, lifecycle context still uses its own record. One bad invalidate name diagnoses without rerunning an already successful mutation.

tasks.title: Implement text and numeric model controls
implementationSteps: Validate writable path, supported control type, and conflicting bind sinks. Reject file inputs and non-controls for ui-model.
Text/textarea controls use input; maintain per-control composition flag, suppress writes from compositionstart through intermediate input, and commit once at compositionend.

Number/range use valueAsNumber and raw empty detection; empty→null, finite valid→number, invalid text→retain model and set a framework-owned validity message. Clearing/reentering valid text clears only that message.
Initial state writes to controls after persistence; later model updates change DOM only when normalized values differ. Preserve selection/caret and active IME text.
Do not dispatch synthetic input/change from programmatic updates. Register native listeners and validity cleanup with owner.
Type-changing bound input attributes must reselect the supported adapter safely; changes to/from file type are diagnosed and model binding disabled for that control.

tasks.title: Implement checkbox, radio, and select models
implementationSteps: Checkbox model requires boolean and uses checked on change. Reject array-checkbox-model conventions; they are not in this RFC.
Radio groups bind strings and synchronize by name/form ownership plus bound path; only checked radio change writes value. Diagnose inconsistent paths within the same modeled group.
Single select binds the selected string; multiple select binds selected option strings in DOM order, including no selection as empty array.
Model updates check matching radio/options and never synthesize events. Unmatched radio string unchecks the group; unmatched single-select string sets selectedIndex=-1.
On dynamic option/control addition run normal binding synchronization; removal releases registrations. Preserve static labels and native disabled semantics.
Record form-owned model paths for T043 reset snapshots once controls have initial normalized values.

tasks.title: Implement successful-control form serialization
implementationSteps: Build a successful-control sequence using native form association, disabled fieldset semantics, checked/radio state, select options, and actual submitter. Include externally associated controls and preserve document order.

Feature-test FormData(form, submitter); compatibility path inserts submitter pairs at their native position, not blindly at end. Include image-submit coordinate fields from the captured click or zero coordinates for keyboard submission.

JSON mode groups repeated literal names into arrays, converting only number/range controls to finite numbers/null. One occurrence stays scalar; checkboxes serialize their value string, never model boolean.

Reject every File in JSON, including the placeholder File of unselected file input. For multipart omit only unselected placeholder files; preserve explicitly selected zero-byte files using filename/selection metadata.
Form encoding preserves native string values in URLSearchParams; multipart preserves FormData order/files and never manually sets boundary.

GET forms require form encoding and no files/body; merge their pairs into query with same-key replacement semantics. Explicit ui-body bypasses control serialization entirely and requires JSON encoding.

tasks.title: Implement native form validation and submit interception
implementationSteps: Observe the actual submit event and SubmitEvent.submitter; respect form novalidate and submitter formnovalidate. Use native validity checks/reportValidity where validation is required.
Invalid form: focus the first invalid control according to native form order, do not set pending, do not prepare an adapter, and do not fetch.
Valid enhanced form: synchronously capture submitter/model/control data, prevent native navigation, and hand snapshot to action scheduling. A later failure never invokes native submit.
A synchronous serialization/URL/security preparation error produces a local action error and no transmission, with preserved user values.
If static compilation rejected enhancement, leave native action/method behavior available. Prevent duplicate enhancement from both submit listener and submit-button click listener.
Test Enter-to-submit, requestSubmit, multiple submitters, and user edits during debounce. Direct form.submit() retains native bypass behavior and is documented as such.
tasks.acceptance: `submit.required`, `submit.novalidate`, `submit.formnovalidate`, `submit.enter`, `submit.actual-button`, `submit.prepare-reject-no-replay`, `submit.native-invalid-config` pass using request counters and navigation observers.

tasks.title: Implement explicit form reset snapshots
implementationSteps: After state/persistence/initial models resolve, capture immutable values for each distinct model path in the form. Deduplicate shared radio paths and overlapping parent/child paths deterministically by keeping the broadest captured path once.
Register snapshots by form owner/ref. Newly mounted modeled controls capture their path at their own initial mount if the form has no existing snapshot for it.
reset(ref) resolves a form lexically, invokes native reset, then batches restoration of captured paths and clears field errors/owned validity state.
Honor a canceled native reset event by not restoring models/errors. Observe ordinary reset buttons and programmatic form.reset() through the same handler without recursion.
Native file reset remains browser-owned. Do not refetch resources or reset unrelated state/action success data.
Dispose snapshots when the form owner is removed; remounted forms capture new defaults.

tasks.title: Implement server field errors and accessibility associations
implementationSteps: Associate ui-field-error with its nearest action form and literal name; outside-form placement fails. Index all matching successful or unsuccessful controls by name, including external form-associated controls.
On normalized failure render the first string in fields[name] through textContent; keep the full array in the error record.

Create stable document-unique presenter IDs when missing. Append their IDs to matching controls' aria-describedby while preserving existing tokens. Apply owned aria-invalid=true and remember prior values.
Editing a field clears only that field's server-error entry and associated presenter/owned ARIA; retain other fields and global error message. A new accepted submit clears the prior error record.
Cleanup restores only attributes/tokens still owned by the framework, preserving author changes made in the meantime.
Provide a form-summary pattern for unrecognized fields/global errors in docs/examples; no automatic popup or unsafe server markup.

tasks.title: Integrate request accessibility state and form lifecycle
implementationSteps: Define busy region: an action element itself; for resource template its nearest parent element. Maintain a per-element count so one request completion cannot clear aria-busy while another is active.
Preserve preexisting aria-busy values and restore only framework-owned changes. Include preparation/transport pending, exclude trailing debounce wait.
Apply disabled token logic to form-associated submit buttons, including external controls; do not disable fields needed for accurate snapshots before serialization.
Verify failure preserves controls/file selection/models and success does not reset unless reset command is present.
Combine server field errors, ui-body nested model, invalidation, success reset, and finally cleanup in one browser workflow.
Confirm no implicit global completion/error notifications; announcements come from authored live markup or explicitly invoked UI helpers.

tasks.title: Close data and form race conformance
implementationSteps: Generate seeded schedules of at least 500 cases combining dependency changes, response order, adapter delays, refresh, mutation invalidation, disposal, and session reset.
Assert every accepted commit has current owner/generation/key/epoch/invalidation tokens; expose test-only token events without exposing them as public APIs.
Include two subscribers with TTL 0/1000, two with timeout 100/1000, success=null, cache eviction during refresh, and invalidation during backoff.
Test drop/replace with server mutation recorded even after client abort; require UI reconciliation example to GET before retrying a nonidempotent action.
Run full native form/browser matrix and classic/ESM parity. Require zero active transport subscriptions, timers, and event listeners after root unmount.
Record fixture failures as blockers; do not substitute unit test coverage percentages for these cases.
tasks.acceptance: complete M2 evidence with recorded seeds, request timelines, form browser outcomes, and zero-leak assertions.

tasks.title: Discover and validate inline component definitions
implementationSteps: Before instance activation, scan owned declaration positions for native template[ui-component], including declarations appearing after instances. Do not discover definitions inside uninstantiated route/loop/conditional bodies as new global registries.
Validate a lowercase hyphenated custom-element-compatible name, reject ui- prefix and existing customElements definitions, and reject duplicate root-local names.
Parse ui-props with safe JSON; validate schema keys/types/defaults/required conflicts exactly as C10 states. Compile definition ui-state as per-instance component state.
Capture immutable template source plus compiled reusable plan; do not mutate the original template while instantiating.
Validate duplicate slot placeholder names and static local ID duplicates within a definition. Record static local ID references for T051.
Freeze registry at mount activation. A definition failure prevents only affected instances; other valid definitions and ordinary DOM continue.

tasks.title: Implement explicit component import graph
implementationSteps: Resolve top-level and nested import URLs using C10, enforce same origin and HTTP(S), remove URL hash, reject userinfo, and include canonical URL in root-local graph identity.
Fetch once per root with same-origin credentials, redirect:error, app timeout, root signal, and text/html content type requirement. Share a promise for duplicate imports.

Parse with the private inert template service proved in T007. Accept only definition templates, import templates, whitespace, and comments at top level. Reject scripts/styles at every depth, including inside definitions; do not execute/install them.
Traverse DFS with visiting/visited sets and report the full canonical pathname cycle without sensitive query values. A→B→A fails deterministically.
Resolve dependencies before registering dependent definitions; reject duplicate definitions across files. Record failed URLs so repeated instances do not refetch endlessly.
Bound each request by timeout and all work by root signal. Resolve app.ready after import graph settles, including localized failures; unrelated static bindings can render during loading.

tasks.title: Implement literal and reactive props
implementationSteps: Match declared prop names exactly, retaining kebab case. String literals come from same-name attributes; ui-prop-* compiles caller-scope expressions. Supplying both fails.
Validate missing required, optional null, cloned defaults, explicit null, primitive type, finite number, array, and object values. Do not coerce strings to booleans/numbers.

Preserve allowed host attributes (class/style/id/role/slot/data/aria and recognized standard HTML host attributes); reject unknown nonstandard prop-like attributes. Do not interpret framework data-ui-* as arbitrary host data.
Create readonly props cells in component scope, with caller-side dependency subscriptions owned by the instance. Normalize/copy nested incoming values to prevent mutation escapes.
On valid reactive changes update props and bindings without reinitializing local state. On invalid reactive update preserve last valid prop value, diagnose PROP_TYPE, and do not remount.
Unsubscribe all prop expressions on disposal. Props cannot resolve caller-local variables except through their explicitly passed values.

tasks.title: Implement slot projection with caller scopes
implementationSteps: Capture host child nodes before clearing its render region; associate each with caller lexical scope and original declaration source.
Group element children by literal slot name and remaining nodes under default slot. Preserve source order; ignore formatting-only whitespace for unmatched-content validation.
Validate that each nonempty group has one matching placeholder. Multiple children may share a slot, while duplicate placeholders are invalid.
Replace slot placeholders with owned anchored ranges. Projected plans use caller scope; fallback plans use component scope. Dispose both through instance ownership.
Do not compile projected nodes twice when moving them into rendered light DOM. The transaction journal marks the movement.
When an instance is removed, release projected listeners/resources/refs even though lexical caller scope may remain alive. Never dispose the caller's unrelated state owner.

tasks.title: Implement static ID and ARIA reference rewriting
implementationSteps: Assign each root a document-wide serial and each instance a monotonic serial. Prefix literal definition IDs with `pui-r<root>-c<instance>-`.
Rewrite matching literal for, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, and aria-controls tokens that refer to IDs declared inside that same definition.
Preserve tokens referencing external IDs and caller-projected markup. Dynamic ui-bind-id and dynamically bound ARIA strings are authored values and are not auto-rewritten.
Apply rewriting to each clone before activation. Never mutate the shared definition or prefix an already cloned instance twice.
Detect collisions of generated IDs with existing document IDs and advance the instance serial until its full generated set is unique.
Validate explicit cross-component IDs passed as props in an example; do not infer them by inspecting other component internals.
tasks.acceptance: `ids.two-instances`, `ids.multitoken-aria`, `ids.external-retained`, `ids.projected-unchanged`, `ids.dynamic-explicit`, `ids.generated-collision` pass with label and accessible-name assertions.

tasks.title: Implement instance lifecycle and custom events
implementationSteps: Preserve the custom host and create an instance owner/component scope. Initialize copied props/defaults/local state, then render cloned light DOM through the normal compiler.

Instantiate nested components recursively through registry lookup. Detect infinite direct/indirect static self-instantiation with a depth limit of 128 instance ancestors and COMPONENT_RECURSION diagnostic; a finite conditional recursion still must stay within the limit.
Bind host ui-on custom-event handlers in caller scope; internal emit dispatches from the component host with bubbling/composed detail.

Validate custom event names as lowercase `[a-z][a-z0-9-]*`, excluding native/lifecycle reserved names where ambiguous. No static event declaration syntax is added; a registered component host authorizes its nonreserved custom handlers.
On reactive props update preserve host/local state/slot ownership. On conditional/route/removal disposal release all nested resources, projected owners, ID/ref claims, and behaviors once.
On import/schema failure preserve authored host fallback content and emit local diagnostics; do not mark a failed instance as successfully mounted.

tasks.title: Close component integration and import lifetime tests
implementationSteps: Build a product-card fixture with typed object props, stateful quantity, named/default slots, local resource, caller event, and linked form labels.
Render 100 keyed instances, reorder, replace an item with same key, remove half, and unmount root. Check state persistence by key and zero owner/request/listener leakage.
Delay nested imports while toggling the containing branch and resetting the session. No disposed instance can mount after imports resolve.
Run identical component files in two roots with differing stores and in both build distributions. No state/registry/cache data crosses roots.
Verify imported styles/scripts are never installed and strict CSP reports zero violations.
Record source-to-fixture coverage for every component directive and all public prop/slot/error rules.
tasks.acceptance: all component scenarios pass and evidence contains measured lifecycle counts, not just DOM snapshots.

tasks.title: Compile route patterns and destination values
implementationSteps: Parse route segments into literal/parameter/final-catchall records; require `/` prefix except special `*`; validate parameter identifiers and unique names.
Normalize trailing slash, keep root `/`, enforce final catchall, and reject malformed pattern escapes at compile time.
Build the left-to-right rank comparator and overlapping-pattern ambiguity validator. `/users/new` outranks `/users/:id`; `/a/:x/c` and `/a/b/:y` resolve by specificity at segment two.
Parse candidate location per history/hash mode; require same origin/basePath containment. Decode each path segment exactly once and reject malformed percent escapes.
Construct frozen route `{path,params,query,hash}`. Query duplicates become ordered arrays; path excludes basePath. Catchall decoded segments join with slash.
Select fallback `*` only when no ordinary route matches; require exactly one fallback and exactly one outlet in router root.

tasks.title: Install router and intercept eligible navigation
implementationSteps: Implement installRouter(app), claim document router ownership, register route directives/navigation service, and release claim on unmount or failed boot.
Validate root route/outlet declarations without compiling inactive route content. Preserve shared shell and store owners outside outlet.
Install delegated ui-link handling inside root. Accept only unmodified primary clicks on same-origin HTTP(S) anchors within basePath without download or external target.
Leave hash-only same-document anchors, mailto/tel, modified clicks, middle clicks, target=_blank, and ordinary unmarked anchors to browser semantics.

Implement navigate(url) using router only when eligible; otherwise same-origin document navigation. Reject cross-origin command navigation as policy failure; ordinary external anchors remain browser links.
Parse initial document location, select route, and mount after imports/definitions are available. Document deep-link fallback requirements for history mode.

tasks.title: Implement guard preparation and cancellation
implementationSteps: Allocate navigation generation and abort previous pending navigation when a new eligible request arrives; snapshot current committed route as from.
Parse/validate destination before executing guards. Guards see frozen from/to plus signal and run sequentially in registration order.
Any explicit false, thrown exception, or rejected promise cancels without disposing the current route. Only failures emit GUARD_ERROR; false is ordinary cancellation.
Check generation/liveness after each await. Superseded guard results must not update URL, title, focus, outlet, or store.
On guard acceptance create a prepared navigation transaction containing matched plan/new route scope/history intent, then hand off to commit service.
Unregister guards idempotently. Unmount aborts pending guards and forbids post-await navigation commits.

tasks.title: Implement history indexing and canceled traversal restoration
implementationSteps: Adopt initial entry with replaceState, merging `__plainui:{rootSession,index,routeKey,scroll}` into existing history.state. Preserve unrelated state fields.
For accepted programmatic/link navigation, save departure scroll and push exactly one indexed destination entry; same exact URL navigation is a no-op unless explicitly refreshed by resource commands.
Listen for popstate and hashchange as required, deduplicating the two events for one hash traversal. Set scrollRestoration=manual while router owns it and restore the previous value on unmount.
Run guards for traversal using the already-changed browser URL. On cancellation compute corrective delta to the last committed known index and call history.go once.
Suppress only the matching corrective traversal event; do not rerun guards or create entries. A newer navigation invalidates an older correction token safely.

For unknown/unowned history entries, perform normal document navigation without guessing index/delta. Document that the URL may temporarily reflect the attempted browser traversal while guards run, then is restored on cancellation.

tasks.title: Commit route scopes and outlet ownership
implementationSteps: Precompile the destination template plan before disposal when possible; malformed route declarations fail locally with fallback/error rendering rather than corrupting shell.
At commit recheck generation/root liveness, dispose the old route range, publish new readonly route cell, create a fresh route scope, and mount destination into the sole outlet.
Always create a fresh scope on parameter changes even for same route pattern. Keep root store and shared shell owners untouched.
Commit URL/history intent once and synchronize committed index/route identity. Failed guards never reach this stage.
Start new-route resources asynchronously after bindings; loading/error state does not delay committed route visibility.
Mark outlet replacement boundary so fragments cannot own/replace it. Route disposal releases component imports' pending instance claims, forms, behaviors, and resource subscriptions.

tasks.title: Implement titles, focus, scroll, and hash anchors
implementationSteps: Evaluate ui-title after publishing route context; require primitive/null output. Absent preserves prior title; null becomes empty string. Assign document.title as text.
After first route binding flush, focus first h1 inside new range; if it is not focusable temporarily add tabindex=-1. If none exists, focus outlet similarly.
For new navigation scroll to top; for known back/forward restore saved x/y. Hash target inside the new route takes precedence and receives scrollIntoView after mount.

Resolve decoded hash through getElementById scoped to current route/root without injecting a CSS selector. Do not poll indefinitely for async content; expose afterFlush in docs for app-owned delayed anchors.
Restore temporary tabindex when focus leaves or owner disposes. Never focus disconnected nodes or move focus because an unrelated resource refreshed.
Cancel pending focus/scroll postflush tasks when superseded by newer navigation. Keep shared-shell user focus stable during resource-only updates.

tasks.title: Validate hash and history mode end-to-end behavior
implementationSteps: Run identical route fixtures in history and hash modes, including basePath `/app`, query arrays, inner hash anchors, fallback, Unicode, encoded slash, and malformed encoding.
Configure test server history fallback only for document navigations under basePath; API missing routes still return JSON 404 and asset missing routes remain 404.
Reload a nested route and verify selected page, title, params, and API fetches. Hash mode must work with a simple static server without history fallback.
Exercise unsaved form guard cancellation for link, navigate command, back, and forward; compare pre/post URL and DOM and exact history length.
Verify normal links with JavaScript disabled and explain that client fallback cannot manufacture a server HTTP 404 or SEO metadata.
Assert router listeners and modified scrollRestoration are restored on unmount.
tasks.acceptance: both routing modes pass with actual navigation events and recorded host recipes; no document-global state leaks after root removal.

tasks.title: Close composition milestone
implementationSteps: Compose imported components, caller-scoped slots, route parameters, guarded form, persisted store, and resource invalidation into a complete test shell.
Execute 100 transitions alternating two route patterns and changing parameters; delay responses and imports across transitions.
Track cleanup order, focus, history length, store survival, and owner/subscriber plateau; compare classic and ESM output.
Verify instance local IDs remain unique across route remounts and no retained slot references reach disposed scope state.
Run all component/router valid-invalid-lifecycle fixtures and strict-CSP import scenarios.
Store M3 evidence and carry only documented future fragment/UI work forward, not unresolved composition defects.
tasks.acceptance: M3 has no failing component or navigation contract case and all lifetime counts return to baseline between routes.

tasks.title: Implement the sanitizer adapter and exact allowlist
implementationSteps: Instantiate DOMPurify privately per document; do not mutate an application-owned global sanitizer. Register hooks once and remove instance references on final document release.
Configure exactly the RFC tag/attribute lists. Disable default SVG/MathML/custom tags and broad data/ARIA allowances unless routed through PlainUI's explicit attribute predicate.
Remove prohibited subtree tags completely; unwrap other unsupported tags retaining safe descendants. Remove inline style/on*/srcdoc/formaction/formtarget/base/metadata content according to policy.

Validate href/src/action with T026 URL service in the correct sink mode. Form action must be same-origin; target accepts _self/_blank and _blank forces noopener+noreferrer while preserving other safe rel tokens.

Default mode strips every ui-* and data-ui-* before considering ordinary data attributes. Enhanced mode uses the exact C12 directive list plus registered component tags and their validated prop attributes.
Sanitize into a DocumentFragment and return sanitation report counts without raw input. Never append the original response string or later serialize into an unsafe sink.
Re-run policy validation on the sanitized DOM and nested template content; malformed namespace/parser transformations cannot introduce an unreviewed element after sanitizer traversal.

tasks.title: Enforce Trusted Types and HTML sink isolation
implementationSteps: Promote T007's proven parsing services into production with private policy handles. Cache a single policy per runtime/document to avoid duplicate-name failures across roots.
Keep component import parsing restricted to developer-owned explicit import content and full import grammar validation; keep untrusted parsing inside the sanitizer service.
Use DOMPurify DOM-fragment output and DOM node insertion. Reject caller-supplied TrustedHTML as an implicit bypass; it still follows PlainUI policy.
Audit source/build for innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, DOMParser, createContextualFragment, and Trusted Types policy creation; only reviewed service files may contain parsing sinks.
Serve enforced CSP with no inline executable script/no unsafe-eval and explicit policy names. Test core alone, imports, fragments, and full module composition.
A policy-creation/CSP failure reports local FRAGMENT_POLICY/import error and leaves old DOM intact. Do not weaken CSP automatically or install a permissive default policy.
tasks.acceptance: `tt.core`, `tt.import`, `tt.fragment`, `tt.multiroot`, `tt.blocked-policy-preserves`, `tt.no-extra-sinks` pass; browsers without Trusted Types still sanitize identically.

tasks.title: Compile fragment actions and arbitrate targets
implementationSteps: Implement installFragments(app), register HTML action response mode, and reject resource HTML mode or missing target ref.
Resolve target in initiating lexical scope but enforce same root; reject missing/disconnected/ignored targets and prohibited ownership overlaps.

At accepted trigger allocate target generation before async preparation, attach it to action operation, and retain a target lifetime signal. Two different action elements targeting one owner share arbitration.
Validate swap enum/default and enhance boolean; ui-enhance=true without root authorization fails before fetch.
HTML transport uses Accept:text/html unless explicitly overridden, text/html success requirement, action pending/error state, and no JSON resource mutation.
A superseded operation may settle cancellation/finally for its own live action but cannot swap, update target ref, move focus, or revive a disposed target.

tasks.title: Prepare detached fragment candidates
implementationSteps: Sanitize response before touching live destination. Build a provisional owner/scope graph that can be discarded without DOM or registry side effects.
In untrusted mode perform no directive compilation; all inserted markup stays ordinary inert-to-PlainUI content except the internal transferred target ref for outer mode.

In enhanced mode compile allowed bindings/declarations/components against destination scope; reject root/store/route/import/definition/persistence/ui-toasts directives and unavailable modules before commit.

Validate ref/name conflicts against retained destination scope, excluding owners scheduled for replacement. Validate static ID conflicts with retained document nodes; duplicates within candidate fail.

For outer require one surviving top-level Element, ignoring whitespace/comments, and same explicit ref in enhanced mode or sidecar ref transfer in untrusted mode. Reject roots/outlets/component hosts/active loop ranges/action ancestors.
Do not start resource loads, behaviors, listeners, timers, persistence, or user commands while preparing. Release provisional allocations on any failure.

tasks.title: Commit all six swap modes transactionally
implementationSteps: Recheck owner/action/target generations, epoch, destination connectivity, and ownership restrictions immediately before commit.

inner: dispose target child owners, remove children, insert candidate, retain target element/scope/ref/host behavior. outer: dispose target owner, insert one replacement at original position, and register retained target ref identity.

append/prepend: insert an owned anchored range at the appropriate child position. before/after: insert sibling range with parent ownership and destination lifetime link. Preserve ordering for sequential accepted insertions.
Use one framework DOM transaction so MutationObserver cannot independently mount inserted nodes. Attach candidate owners then activate bindings/listeners/behaviors/resources in normal phase order.

If precommit checks fail, discard candidate with old DOM untouched. If unexpected activation throws after disposal, display fixed safe local failure text, emit FRAGMENT_ACTIVATION, settle action error, and keep other root regions usable.
Treat completed swap as accepted action success; then run normal invalidation/lifecycle flow if configured for mutation. Never resurrect a disposed old subtree.

tasks.title: Preserve focus and enforce fragment ownership boundaries
implementationSteps: Capture active element before commit. If it survives connected and inside permitted ownership, preserve it without focus calls.
If removed, focus target/replacement using temporary tabindex=-1 after binding flush; for sibling insertion target remains the focus fallback. Restore temporary tabindex after blur/disposal.

Reject swaps into/around router-owned replaceable outlet ranges and component-rendered internals where target ownership would overlap. Explicit component-owned fragment targets are allowed only within its ordinary owned local region, not its host replacement.
Validate action-ancestor outer prohibition by owner/DOM ancestry, not selector strings.
Dispose destination-linked sibling insertions when destination or route owner is removed. A surviving old action completion cannot recreate them.
Show loading/error only through initiating action record; avoid adding unexplained global busy overlays.

tasks.title: Build the fragment security regression suite

Include encoded javascript URLs, mixed-case schemes, control characters, SVG/MathML namespace confusion, malformed nesting, table foster parenting, template nesting, DOM clobbering IDs/names, and mutation-XSS regression cases compatible with the pinned sanitizer.
Execute fixtures in real browsers under CSP with script execution/network beacons instrumented; forbidden payload execution or transmission fails the test even if final DOM looks safe.
Verify same-origin content is sanitized, failed HTTP HTML never swaps, and enhanced trust cannot be enabled by response markup itself.
Verify sanitized nodes after insertion still satisfy policy, including nested registered components and slot projections.
Save exact sanitizer version/integrity/policy hash, test corpus hashes, browsers, and outcomes. Rerun this suite on any dependency/policy change.
tasks.acceptance: no forbidden executable effect, policy bypass, late-target commit, or preserved-DOM failure; all corpus cases named in evidence.

tasks.title: Implement behavior factories and widget ownership
implementationSteps: Parse ui-use as ordered space-separated unique names; reject duplicate/unknown names. ui-options is a safe JSON object, not expression text.
Invoke factories in declaration order with element, frozen copied options, scoped API, and owner signal, after initial bindings and before eligible network starts.

Require optional cleanup function return; reject promises/nonfunction nonundefined returns. If a later factory fails, clean up already-started factories in reverse order and mark that behavior owner failed.
Provide afterFlush cancellation, scoped refs/emit/state/refresh, and lifecycle checks. Trusted factory code may retain non-JSON widget objects privately.
Enforce documented inner ui-ignore boundary for widgets owning descendants; PlainUI may remove the whole host but never traverse the widget subtree.
Cleanup runs once with host still connected, after scope is inactive. Leaked postdispose writes diagnose and are rejected.

open(ref) requires a connected native HTMLDialogElement in lexical root, usable showModal, and C13 accessible name; unknown/wrong targets fail locally.
Capture connected opener from activeElement, call showModal, rely on native focus containment/Escape semantics, and track open state per dialog.
close(ref) calls native close only when open and restores focus to connected focusable opener after close; a removed opener produces no focus attempt.
Handle native close/cancel events consistently. Respect author-canceled cancel events; do not forcibly close a prevented Escape action.
Disposal closes/releases controller listeners and focus references without running commands into dead scopes.
